mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% (0.8pp increase) signals worsening labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.8pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales and housing starts indicate a broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (INDPRO decline), a federal funds rate cut signals aggressive monetary policy response, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS declines in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales signals weak consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days across all regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals weakening real economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in payrolls signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1300 thousand units signal a housing market collapse, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1300.0.
